bounded_host_request.command: set -u; output=$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/reconcileAreaEntries.mjs 2>&1); code=$?; if test "$code" -eq 0; then exit 0; fi; if printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q AREA_L2_CANONICAL_COVERAGE_INVALID; then exit 71; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q BOT_TOKEN_FILE_UNSAFE; then exit 72; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q DATABASE_URL_REQUIRED; then exit 73; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND; then exit 74; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q AREA_LINK; then exit 75; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q BOT_IDENTITY_UNEXPECTED; then exit 76; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q connect; then exit 77; else exit 78; fi
